proposed_fixes.title: Preserve existing whitespace in formatting-only renames
proposed_fixes.root_cause: DoRename sends the empty-search fallback through GetTrimmedFileName before applying the selected text transform. GetTrimmedFileName removes leading characters classified by iswspace, so a valid leading U+3000 IDEOGRAPHIC SPACE is lost even when the transform is a no-op; the same path affects Extension only.
plan: Separate formatting-only candidates from user-edited rename output so an unchanged source name is not normalized before case formatting.

Preserve leading whitespace from the original name; retain only the platform-required handling of invalid trailing characters, and do not treat arbitrary Unicode whitespace as removable filename padding.
Add regression tests for a leading U+3000 name with empty search in Title Case, Capitalize Each Word, and Extension only; assert no rename candidate is produced when formatting is a no-op.
verification: Run focused PowerRename native tests for empty-search formatting and GetTrimmedFileName.
Verify a filename beginning with U+3000 remains unchanged in the preview for Title Case and Extension only when no letters are changed.

confidence.rationale: The report specifies a reproducible Unicode filename and the current trim-before-transform code directly explains the lost prefix; the fix can be constrained to preserving existing input on a no-op formatting path.
